title: Reported Speech
objectives: Zaman kayması kurallarını tüm temel zamanlara uygulamak
Zaman, yer ve zamir değişikliklerini yapmak

sections.title: Reported speech: zaman kayması
paragraphs: A2’de reported speech’in temelini gördün. B1’de tüm zamanları, zaman ifadelerinin değişimini ve emir cümlelerinin aktarımını öğreniyoruz.
Genel kural: Aktaran fiil geçmişteyse (said, told) cümlenin zamanı bir adım geriye kayar. Zamirler ve zaman/yer ifadeleri anlama göre değişir.

forms.label: must → had to
forms.note: Aktarımda: must go → had to go

sections.title: Değişmeyenler
paragraphs: Past Perfect, would, could, might, should ve ought to değişmez. Past Simple da Past Perfect’e çevrilmeyebilir; ama B1’de sınav kuralı olarak çevir.

formulas.label: Değişmez
formulas.pattern: had V3 / would / should / might → aynı kalır

forms.label: now → then
forms.note: Aktarımda: now → then / at that time

forms.note: Aktarımda: tomorrow → the next day / the following day

forms.note: Aktarımda: yesterday → the day before / the previous day

forms.note: Aktarımda: last week → the week before

sections.title: Zamirler
paragraphs: Zamirler aktaran kişinin bakış açısına göre değişir: my → his / her, I → he / she, you → I / he / she / they.

sections.title: Say ve tell
paragraphs: Tell’den sonra kişi gelir (told me). Say’den sonra kişi yoksa doğrudan söz gelir; kişi eklenecekse say to me kullanılır.

sections.title: Emir ve rica
paragraphs: Emir cümleleri tell + kişi + to + V1 ile aktarılır. Olumsuzda not to kullanılır.

sections.title: Zaman kaymayabilir
paragraphs: Söylenen şey genel bir doğruysa ya da hâlâ geçerliyse zaman kaydırmak zorunlu değildir: She said the Earth goes round the Sun.

items.body: Say ve tell arasındaki fark ayrı bir derste incelenir.
Past Simple geriye kayınca Past Perfect olur.

sections.title: Dikkat edilecekler
items: Said / told geçmişteyse zaman bir adım geri kayar.
Would, could, might, should, had V3 değişmez.

examples.en: “I work in a bank,” he said. → He said he worked in a bank.
“I am tired,” she said. → She said she was tired.
“I'm watching TV,” he said. → He said he was watching TV.
“I visited Rome,” she said. → She said she had visited Rome.
examples.tr: “Roma'yı ziyaret ettim” dedi. → Roma'yı ziyaret ettiğini söyledi.

examples.en: “I have finished,” he said. → He said he had finished.
“I will call you,” she said. → She said she would call me.
“I can swim,” he said. → He said he could swim.
“I must go,” she said. → She said she had to go.
“I may come,” he said. → He said he might come.
“You should rest,” she said. → She said I should rest.
“I had left,” he said. → He said he had left.
“I would help,” she said. → She said she would help.
“I'm busy now,” he said. → He said he was busy then.
examples.tr: “Şimdi meşgulüm” dedi. → O sırada meşgul olduğunu söyledi.

examples.en: “I'll come tomorrow,” she said. → She said she would come the next day.

examples.tr: “Onu dün gördüm” dedi. → Onu bir gün önce gördüğünü söyledi.

examples.en: “I'll see you next month,” she said. → She said she would see me the following month.
examples.tr: “Seni gelecek ay göreceğim” dedi. → Ertesi ay beni göreceğini söyledi.

examples.en: “I started two years ago,” he said. → He said he had started two years before.
examples.tr: “İki yıl önce başladım” dedi. → İki yıl önce başladığını söyledi.

examples.en: “I like this house,” she said. → She said she liked that house.

examples.en: “I live here,” he said. → He said he lived there.
“My car is new,” she said. → She said her car was new.
examples.tr: “Arabam yeni” dedi. → Arabasının yeni olduğunu söyledi.

examples.en: He told me that he was tired.
She said that she was ill.
“Open the window,” she said. → She told me to open the window.
“Don't touch it,” he said. → He told me not to touch it.
She said the Earth goes round the Sun.
He said he didn't know the answer.
